section_summary: This section covers administrative procedures and clearances for commercial entrants, transit travelers, and foreign nationals seeking entry into or departure from occupied Japan between late December 1948 and January 1949. It features SCAP Circular No. 19 of June 23, 1948, establishing comprehensive occupation regulations governing entry and exit controls for individuals, aircraft, and merchant and combatant vessels. Individual cases include commercial applicants sponsored by the Department of Commerce, South African, Burmese, Syrian, and Greek businessmen, the repatriation of Peruvian and Cuban nationals, Korean transit passengers, and missionary exit permit waivers.

subfiles.about: Promulgating comprehensive regulations on the control of entry and exit of persons, aircraft, and vessels.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This circular establishes detailed procedures and responsibilities for controlling the entry and exit of individuals, aircraft, and surface vessels into and from occupied Japan. It designates authorized air and sea ports of entry, outlines application requirements for military personnel, dependents, and commercial entrants, and details customs and quarantine inspections. Inclosures provide standard forms for exit permits, exit and reentry permits, and merchant vessel entry applications.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 19: Control of Entry and Exit of Individuals, Aircraft and Surface Vessels Into and From Japan
subfiles.to: General distribution
